 Exclusive: Samsung improves Privacy Display for Galaxy S27 Pro and S27 Ultra
 The Galaxy S27 and the Galaxy S27+ will not have that feature.
 Asif Iqbal Shaik 
 Reading time: 2 minutes
 Follow us on Google Discover 
 Add us as preferred source 
 Abhijeet Mishra / SamMobile
 Phone 
 Galaxy S26 Ultra's Privacy Display options
 TL;DR
 Samsung’s Galaxy S27 Pro and S27 Ultra will get an upgraded Privacy Display feature, expanding it beyond Ultra-only models for the first time.
 The two premium models will also have brighter screens for better outdoor visibility.
 The standard Galaxy S27 and S27+ are not expected to include Privacy Display.
 The Galaxy S26 Ultra introduced the groundbreaking Privacy Display feature earlier this year, and since then, several other brands have implemented a similar technology in their high-end phones. Now, Samsung is ready to improve upon it with the upcoming Galaxy S27 series.
 Privacy Display is expanding beyong Galaxy S Ultra models
 We can exclusively confirm that the Galaxy S27 Pro and Galaxy S27 Ultra will not only feature Privacy Display, but they will also use an upgraded version of it. It would be the first time Samsung is expanding the feature to non-Ultra models. 
 Additionally, these phones will have enhanced display brightness, making their screens much easier to read in under direct sunlight. 
 Unfortunately, the standard Galaxy S27 and Galaxy S27+ will lack this feature. It appears Samsung prefers to reserve Privacy Display for its most premium Galaxy S models.
 With Privacy Display 
 Upgrade To Galaxy S26 Ultra
 Check Deals 
 Previous reports indicate that the Galaxy S27 Pro and Galaxy S27 Ultra will sport a 200MP primary rear camera, a 50MP ultrawide camera with autofocus, and a 16MP front-facing camera.
 The Galaxy S27 Pro will likely include a 10MP or 12MP telephoto lens, while the Galaxy S27 Ultra is expected to feature a 50MP telephoto camera with 5x optical zoom.
